binaries : Improve rpc-server and export-graph-ops names. (#25045)

Tests are generally prefixed with -test, so rename export-graph-ops
accordingly.

rpc-server is probably too generic a name for /usr/bin. Because it
should work with any ggml application, it is renamed to ggml-rpc-se

faq_items.answer: DeepSeek's DSpark accelerates per-user generation by 60–85% over MTP-1 through speculative decoding.
